description: Recent enforcement items from the regulators' own feeds: SEC litigation releases and administrative proceedings, CFPB enforcement actions, FTC consumer-protection and competition press releases, DOJ press releases. Each: agency, feed, title, date, link, a short summary and, for SEC and CFPB, the respondent named in the title. Filters: agency, words (q), days (1-90). The feeds hold the latest 25-30 items each. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

agency.description: sec, cfpb, ftc or doj; omit for all

days.description: Look back this many days, 1 to 90, default 30

q.description: Words that must appear in the title or summary (optional)

name: enforcement_actions
title: Enforcement Actions
